run_pipeline_parallelism: run the Pipeline class to execute pipeline parallelism across multiple partitions and devices with micro-batches
create_pipeline_partitions: create a Pipeline instance with nn.Sequential partitions, devices, copy streams, skip layout, and checkpoint stop configuration
generate_pipeline_schedule: generate pipeline execution schedules using _clock_cycles with micro-batch count and partition count
fence_microbatch_copies: fence micro-batch tensor copies between pipeline stages to ensure correct ordering of forward and backward passes
compute_pipeline_partitions: compute pipeline partitions across devices with optional gradient checkpointing and stream synchronization
